description: Salary statistics over the live Level listings that publish a yearly salary range: number of listings, median, 25th and 75th percentile of the middle of each range, in one currency at a time (default USD, currencies are never mixed). Hourly and monthly rates are excluded. Optional filters: keyword in the job title, AI level (1 = Little AI, 2 = Uses AI, 3 = Works on AI, 4 = Builds AI), remote. The response carries the date of the figures and the exact method. Computed directly from the database, not an estimate.

ai_level.description: Keep only listings at exactly this AI level (1 to 4).

currency.description: Three-letter currency code (default USD). Only listings in this currency are counted.

query.description: Keyword in the job title, e.g. "machine learning".

remote.description: true to keep remote roles only.

name: salary_stats
title: Salary statistics on Level
